items.question: Charu travelled 5 km 580 m, then 1 km 750 m, then 250 m. Find the total distance she travelled.
items.answer: 5 km 580 m + 1 km 750 m + 250 m = 7 km 580 m. So, Charu travelled 7 km 580 m in total.

items.question: Priya jumps a distance of 3 m 25 cm, which is 48 cm more than her first jump. How far was her first jump?
items.answer: 3 m 25 cm − 48 cm = 2 m 77 cm. So, Priya's first jump was 2 m 77 cm.

items.question: Three pieces of wire measure 4 m 50 cm, 6 m 25 cm and 5 m 70 cm. Find the total length of wire.
items.answer: 4 m 50 cm + 6 m 25 cm + 5 m 70 cm = 16 m 45 cm. So, the length of the wire is 16 m 45 cm.

items.question: Sohan bought vegetables weighing 1 kg 500 g, 2 kg 500 g and 2 kg. Find the total weight of the vegetables bought.
items.answer: 1 kg 500 g + 2 kg 500 g + 2 kg = 6 kg. So, the total weight of the vegetables bought by Sohan is 6 kg.

items.question: The weight of the first bag is 3 kg 350 g, which is 1 kg 200 g more than the second bag. Find the weight of the second bag.
items.answer: 3 kg 350 g − 1 kg 200 g = 2 kg 150 g. So, the weight of the second bag is 2 kg 150 g.

items.question: There was 6 kg of rice at the start of the month. 4 kg 540 g was used. How much rice is left at the end of the month?
items.answer: 6 kg − 4 kg 540 g = 1 kg 460 g. So, 1 kg 460 g of rice is left at the end of the month.

items.question: A box of fruits has 6 kg 285 g of one fruit and 2 kg 345 g of another. Find the total weight of fruits in the box.
items.answer: 6 kg 285 g + 2 kg 345 g = 8 kg 630 g. So, the total weight of fruits in the box is 8 kg 630 g.

items.question: A vessel already has 6 l 600 ml of water and can hold 9 l 200 ml in total. How much more water can be added to the vessel?
items.answer: 9 l 200 ml − 6 l 600 ml = 2 l 600 ml. So, 2 l 600 ml more water can be added to the vessel.

items.question: A bottle had 2 l of water. 1 l 575 ml was used. How much water is left in the bottle?
items.answer: 2 l − 1 l 575 ml = 425 ml. So, 425 ml of water is left in the bottle.

items.question: Aanvi bought two pieces of cloth measuring 5 m 60 cm and 4 m 75 cm. Find the total length of cloth she bought.
items.answer: 5 m 60 cm + 4 m 75 cm = 10 m 35 cm. So, Aanvi bought 10 m 35 cm of cloth in total.

items.question: Gaurav bought vegetables and fruits weighing 2 kg 500 g, 3 kg, 500 g and 2 kg. Find the total weight he bought.
items.answer: 2 kg 500 g + 3 kg + 500 g + 2 kg = 8 kg. So, Gaurav bought 8 kg of vegetables and fruits.
